tool_activity.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!*__pycache__*'"' -g '*' . && printf '%s\\n' '--- TASK.md ---' && sed -n '1,240p' TASK.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- materials files ---' && rg --files materials && printf '%s\\n' '--- candidate ---' && sed -n '1,260p' candidate.py"

/bin/bash -c "for f in 'materials/triton-semantics.rst' 'materials/vector_add.py' 'materials/core.py' 'materials/standard.py' 'materials/math.py' 'materials/extra/cuda/libdevice.py'; do printf '%s\\n' \"--- "'$f ---"; sed -n '"'1,280p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -c "rg -n \"TRITON_MAX_TENSOR_NUMEL|def sum|def reduce|tl\\.sum|num_warps|MAX\" materials/core.py materials/standard.py materials/triton-semantics.rst | head -120 && sed -n '1100,1260p' materials/standard.py && sed -n '1080,1210p' materials/core.py"
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '260,340p' materials/standard.py && sed -n '1170,1255p' materials/core.py && sed -n '2610,2705p' materials/core.py && rg -n \"TRITON_MAX_TENSOR_NUMEL\" materials"
/bin/bash -c "rg -n \"def arange|validate_block_shape|class reduction|reduction\\(\" materials/core.py | head -80 && sed -n '1620,1685p' materials/core.py && sed -n '2240,2335p' materials/core.py"

reason: Replaced the two-stage partial reduction with one autotuned Triton kernel that fuses add and mean over the fixed 1M-element input, reducing intermediate storage and launch overhead.
